steps.en: The system loads classified-vehicle notices with their current and past suspensions
steps.id: Sistem memuat notice classified vehicle beserta suspend aktif dan riwayatnya

steps.en: The system spots notices already suspended under another code
steps.id: Sistem mengenali notice yang sudah disuspend dengan kode lain

steps.en: The system also spots notices whose classified suspension lapsed while another one runs
steps.id: Sistem juga mengenali notice yang suspend classified-nya berakhir saat suspend lain masih jalan
steps.why_en: By reading, the check may keep matching and add a new suspension each day; not confirmed.
steps.why_id: Dari bacaan code, pengecekan ini bisa terus cocok dan menambah suspend baru tiap hari; belum dikonfirmasi.

steps.en: Classified suspension starts only once the other suspension has ended
steps.id: Suspend classified baru mulai setelah suspend lain berakhir
steps.why_en: The system applies it at once, alongside the other suspension, instead of waiting for it to end.
steps.why_id: Sistem memasangnya langsung bersamaan dengan suspend lain, bukan menunggu suspend itu berakhir.

steps.en: The notice stays suspended without a gap
steps.why_en: A failed attempt is only logged and retried the next day, so a gap is possible.
steps.why_id: Percobaan yang gagal hanya dicatat dan diulang besok, jadi celah masih mungkin.
